learning_outcomes.text: Record actions with the Action Recorder and read the generated script
Edit scripts in the Code Editor using the ExcelScript TypeScript API
Read from and write to ranges, tables and worksheets reliably
Add defensive checks so scripts fail safely on missing objects
Trigger a script from a Power Automate flow

integrative_case: A team re-formats a daily CSV the same way each morning; record the steps as an Office Script, harden it with existence checks, and run it automatically from a Power Automate flow triggered on file arrival.
